svg.text: STAGE 391 · TOPIC 31 FAQ
Native S2S Emotional Contagion Clamp & Syntactic Incomplete-Turn Hold
ITU-R BS.1770-4 [-20,-16] LUFS + Prosodic Mirroring Clamp (P775) & 1,100–1,600ms Syntactic EOU Hold + C2PA Watermark (P776)
1. Native S2S Emotional Contagion & ITU-R BS.1770-4 Clamp (P775)
❌ Anti-Pattern: Autoregressive S2S Shouting Mirroring (-6 LUFS, 210 WPM)
• Angry caller yells at -6 LUFS -> native audio-token S2S mirrors high pitch/energy
• AI shouts back sarcastically or clips DAC at 0 dBFS, escalating customer fury
• Result: 14.8% prosodic escalation incidents & severe brand PR liability
✅ Production Pattern: Prosodic Decoupling & -18 LUFS Normalization (P775)
1. Input Prosody Conditioning Clamp: Attenuate >-10 LUFS input before S2S encoder
2. ITU-R BS.1770-4 Loudness Lock: Normalize outbound TTS/S2S to [-20, -16] LUFS
3. Cadence & True-Peak Ceiling: Clamp speech rate to 135–165 WPM & <=-1.0 dBTP
4. Zero Shouting Contagion: Cuts S2S emotional mirroring from 14.8% to 0.0%
Deterministic Invariant (evaluateNativeS2sEmotionalContagion...):
targetLoudnessLufs in [-20.0, -16.0] && maxSpeechRateWpm in [135, 165]
2. Syntactic Incomplete-Clause Hold & C2PA Dual Watermark (P776)
❌ Anti-Pattern: 500ms VAD Cuts Off Dangling Conjunctions + Unsigned Audio
• Caller says "Transfer $5,000 to..." and pauses 650ms to check account number
• Naive 500ms VAD fires prematurely; outbound AI audio lacks C2PA provenance
• Result: 27.4% mid-thought interruption rate & unverifiable audio provenance
✅ Production Pattern: 1,100–1,600ms Syntactic Hold + C2PA SNR >=38dB (P776)
1. Dangling-Clause Detector: Detect trailing conjunctions/prepositions ("to", "因为")
2. Dynamic EOU Expansion: Extend turn-taking hold to 1,100ms–1,600ms on open syntax
3. Dual Provenance Watermark: Embed C2PA v2.1 manifest + spread-spectrum watermark
4. Imperceptible Fidelity: Maintains watermark SNR >= 38dB & cuts cut-offs by 84%
Deterministic Invariant (evaluateSyntacticIncompleteClauseHold...):
syntacticHoldMs in [1100, 1600] && minAcousticWatermarkSnrDb >= 38dB

• Emotional Contagion Gate (P775): 0.0% shouting mirroring at -18 LUFS; Syntactic Hold Gate (P776): Cuts mid-clause interruptions by 84%.
